apps.name: Caffeinate
apps.subtitle: Keep your device awake, like caffeinate on Mac.
apps.localizedDescription:
A tiny app whose only job is to keep your iPhone or iPad awake, similar to the caffeinate command on macOS.

• One button — tap to keep the screen on, tap again to allow sleep
• Optional "dim screen while awake" toggle to save battery
• Shortcuts actions so you can automate it — e.g. keep the device awake automatically whenever a chosen app is open, and let it sleep again when you close that app

Universal app for iPhone and iPad. Requires iOS 17 or later.
